corrected_content.problem: Let $\mathbf{a}=\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ 0\end{bmatrix}$ and $\mathbf{b}=\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ -2\end{bmatrix}$. Find a unit vector that is parallel to $\mathbf{a}+3\mathbf{b}$ and points the same direction.
corrected_content.worked_solution: First $a+3b=\langle-1,0\rangle+3\langle3,-2\rangle=\langle8,-6\rangle$. Its norm is $10$. Dividing by this positive norm preserves direction and gives the unit vector $\langle4/5,-3/5\rangle$.
